name: explain-source-use
displayName: Explain a room's use of organization records
description: For an organization admin deciding whether a room may read organization records: says in plain words what the room's scheduled tasks would do with them, and whether that fits the purpose the room states; for a task changed after the grant, what the change does.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Two or three sentences: what the scheduled tasks would read, what they would do with it and who would see the result

fields.name: uses
fields.description: Each thing the tasks would do with the records, one short line each

fields.name: mismatch
fields.description: Empty when the tasks fit the stated purpose; else one sentence on what goes beyond it
